note: Chosen on the dev styles only. Held-out styles and real artwork are scored once with exactly these settings.

v2_cnn.rule: CNN probability for the name >= threshold
v2_cnn.training: 4000 procedural crops per class + crops mined from styled_train (seed 13), 25 epochs, seed 0

v2_sil_and_cnn.rule: both accept; score is the smaller

candidate_finder: src/cv/symbols_v2/candidates.py defaults (work short side 600, closings 3 and 9, size 4.5% to 30% of short side, aspect 0.5 to 2, ink share 0.10 to 0.97)

datasets.external_original_style: fresh100 to fresh102 and freshneg100 to freshneg102 (original artwork and alt_style)
